snippet.title: Hollowbody - Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Acclaimed Tech-noir Survival Horror Hollowbody is coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on June 5th.

Hollowbody will launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at midnight UTC on June 5. Please refer to the list below for region-specific timing.

Los Angeles, USA - 17:00 PDT - June 4
New York, USA - 20:00 EDT - June 4
London, UK - 01:00 BST - June 5
Central Europe - 02:00 CEST - June 5
Tokyo, Japan - 09:00 JST - June 5

A dystopian love letter to survival horror set in the near-future, players take control of Mica, an unlicensed black market shipper who will stop at nothing to find her missing partner. She will have to push her way through the zone, solve environmental puzzles, manage resources and fight for her life as she tries to find a way to escape beyond the wall.
